description: Use this only when the user explicitly asks to test an IMAP login for a mailbox they control and provides its credentials. Connects to the IMAP server and reports whether connection, encryption and authentication succeed. Credentials are not stored.

imap_encryption.description: The encryption protocol: ssl, tls, or none

imap_host.description: The IMAP server hostname, e.g. imap.gmail.com

imap_port.description: The IMAP port number, e.g. 993 for SSL, 143 for unencrypted

password.description: The IMAP password or app-specific password

name: imap_check
title: IMAP Check
